description: This file contains the implementation of a RecyclerView adapter for displaying TV channel cards in an Android TV frontend application. It defines a class that manages a list of TV channel data, inflates item layouts, binds data to views, and handles UI behaviors such as focus scaling with animations.

classes.name: TvChannelCardAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView.Adapter implementation that manages and displays a list of TV channel cards with multiple UI elements and focus behavior.

classes.name: TvChannelViewHolder
classes.description: Inner class that holds references to the views within each TV channel card item, and manages focus animations.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item layout and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from a TvChannelCard object to the UI elements of the ViewHolder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of channels in the list.
